messages:
Evie (ML Eng): flagging a weird delta we saw in the onboarding run for v3.1 — q4b shows higher hallucination on the token-remediation holdout vs float16 baseline. concentrated on code fences and deid examples. tagging @Tom @Priya
Priya (Annot Ops): do we have the delta numbers?
Evie (ML Eng): on the 25k prompt bank the hallucination proxy (model_confidence->fuzzy_match) moved +7% for cohort='token_remediation'. raw: `SELECT cohort, count(*) FROM holdout_eval WHERE model='v3.1_q4b' AND fail=true GROUP BY cohort;` returned 1897 for token_remediation (was 1776 on fp16)
Tom (Curation): were these in the golden or candidate anchors? any overlap with the recent normalizer change?
Evie (ML Eng): overlap: ~220 in golden, another ~1.2k in candidate anchors. we recently enabled whitespace_norm v1.3 which changed canonicalization of backticks — suspect dedupe/normalizer mismatch + quant rounding on rare tokens.
Jin (Quant): plausible. q4b kernel changes + tokenizer boundary shifts can alter kv-cache alignment for code spans. can you push a small repro slice?
Evie (ML Eng): uploading 600-example repro slice: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3809994321/repro_600.jsonl
Priya (Annot Ops): I'll start a prioritized relabel for the 220 golden first — labelers want both q4b and fp16 outputs inline. batch size 20. ETA 30h.
Tom (Curation): before relabeling let's run a dedupe + canonicalizer diff: `tools/normalize/canon_diff.py repro_600.jsonl --norm whitespace_norm_v1.2 whitespace_norm_v1.3` to see changed fingerprints. will run now.
AutoCI: dedupe job queued: job=dedupe-3809, input=repro_600.jsonl, config=fuzzyhash_v2. Logs will appear at gs://ci-logs/dedupe-3809.log
Evie (ML Eng): also create tokenization diffs: `tools/tokenize/diff.py --in repro_600.jsonl --out token_diffs.jsonl` so quant can inspect splits
Jin (Quant): will run token-level sensitivity: `quant_tools/sensitivity.py --model v3.1 --slice repro_600 --topk 100` to see which tokens have high variance in logit magnitude under quantization
Priya (Annot Ops): relabel job started: lbl-8833, targets=220, note="focus: deid mask correctness + hallucination flag (0-3)". attached outputs archive: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3809994321/outputs.zip
Tom (Curation): dedupe finished: 600 -> 548 after fuzzyhash_v2 + whitespace_norm_v1.3. diff shows 34 items changed canonical form vs v1.2. log: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3809994321/dedupe.log
Priya (Annot Ops): relabel progress 20/220 — annotators flagging many instances where fp16 and q4b differ only in punctuation inside codeblocks; they're asking for a small rubric update: treat punctuation-only mismatches as non-hallucination unless meaning changes.
Evie (ML Eng): updated rubric: add rule "punctuation-only token insertions/deletions in code fences = ignore for hallucination unless syntactic change". updated guide at gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3809994321/rubric.md
Jin (Quant): token sensitivity run posted: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3809994321/token_sensitivity.json — early signal: rare delimiter tokens (```, {, }) show high logit variance under q4b. recommend trying per-channel scaling on attention layers 5-12 and a small alpha kl-correction for the embedding matrix.
Evie (ML Eng): can we run a micro-quant profile targeting those layers? keep latency change <3%.
Jin (Quant): starting targeted quant: profile-3809, layers=5-12, perchannel=true, kl_alpha=0.15. pushing artifacts to gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3809994321/quant_profile_3809/
AutoCI: relabel job lbl-8833 completed: 220/220. summary: 34 golden consensus changes -> 24 flagged as model hallucination -> 10 GT corrections. detail CSV: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3809994321/relabel_summary.csv
Tom (Curation): propose micro-golden update: add 24 negative checks (expect hallucination=false) and 10 corrected GT replacements. name patch `golden_patch_3809994321`. will include provenance `curation:relabellog=lbl-8833` and `curation:normalizer=whitespace_norm_v1.3`
Priya (Annot Ops): our label leads also want a 20m calibration huddle tomorrow to review edgecases. I'll schedule.
Jin (Quant): quant_profile_3809 results: hallucination on the 24 micro-golden items reduced by 58% vs q4b baseline, latency +2.4%, memory +0.6%. report: gs://redwood-test/qbringup/3809994321/quant_profile_3809/report.md
Evie (ML Eng): great. Tom please stage micro-golden patch in staging; Priya ramp a 2-week daily sample (n=40) from production token_remediation cohort for early regressions.
Tom (Curation): patch staged, awaiting PR review. included dedupe fingerprint and canonicalizer diff. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/curation/gold/compare/patch-3809994321
Priya (Annot Ops): calibration done. labeler consistency good. we'll start the daily monitoring tomorrow morning.
OpsBot: created incident INC-2009 to track artifacts and infra. artifacts archived under the ticket.
Evie (ML Eng): follow-ups: Jin to open RFC for targeted quant fallback policy for token_remediation route if micro-golden holds; Tom to merge micro-golden on PR approval; Priya to start 14-day monitoring. Thanks all :rocket:
AutoCI: thread auto-archived.
